translation_notes: prefixes: RDF->rdf; four g.add on the same subject n become one `+{ {n} a rdf:Statement ; rdf:subject {s[0]} ; rdf:predicate {s[1]} ; rdf:object {s[2]} }`; RDF['type'] is `a`
`@graph g` inside the method (g is a parameter); `self.conf['new_graph_uri']` is a stub in context_shim.py (a stable IRI derived from the triple)

difference NOT covered by the driver: `g.add((n, p, "plain str"))` raises AssertionError ("Object ... must be an rdflib term") while `rdf:object {s[2]}` coerces a plain Python str to a literal -- the translation is more permissive on an `s` that is not made of rdflib terms (real callers pass terms)
